channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: Bernie Sanders rips Silicon Valley’s supposed good intentions: ‘I don’t believe them’
item.description: The Vermont senator told a Stanford crowd that unchecked AI could deepen inequality, comments echoed by Rep. Ro Khanna.

item.title: Tony Vitello’s spring debut: A comeback, help from familiar faces — and a bruise
item.description: Former Tennessee players Blade Tidwell and Drew Gilbert played key roles in the Giants’ 10-5 win over the Mariners on Saturday.

item.title: The Marina went full F1 Saturday — and it was gloriously chaotic
item.description: Yuki Tsunoda got the biggest cheers, the mayor took a wild ride, while one car threw smoke and flames.

item.title: Photos: Before winning Olympic gold, Alysa Liu was just an East Bay kid
item.description: Ryan Young first photographed the star figure skater for the New York Times in 2018, and again in 2024.

item.title: The 49ers must race to find Christian McCaffrey help before it’s too late
item.description: Unless the 49ers are sure Isaac Guerendo or Jordan James can reliably move the needle next season, they can’t wait around.

item.title: The best tattooers and shops in San Francisco, according to a panel of pros
item.description: San Francisco is blessed with a bevy of storied studios. We asked professionals for their favorite shops and artists across a range of styles.

item.title: ‘It was chaos’: Marina neighbors survey the damage after SF’s F1 event
item.description: Residents reported broken windows, damaged roofs, and people urinating in yards after Saturday’s Red Bull Showrun drew an estimated 40,000 spectators.

item.title: Giants turn triple play, smoker sets off alarm in bizarre game: ‘A glitch in the matrix’
item.description: Robbie Ray stayed on the mound and kept pitching as fans filed out of Scottsdale Stadium during the first inning of Sunday’s game.

item.title: The Warriors brought back Strength in Numbers, and it actually was a Great Time Out
item.description: Golden State beat Nikola Jokic and Denver without Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Kristaps Porzingis, and Jimmy Butler.

item.title: BART halts Transbay Tube service
item.description: It is the latest snafu in BART service after a string of service meltdowns last year.
